rows.candidateRo: Samson a plecat la Gaza; acolo a văzut o curvă și a intrat la ea.
rows.WEBU: Samson went to Gaza, and saw there a prostitute, and went in to her.
rows.WLC: וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ שִׁמְשׁ֖וֹן עַזָּ֑תָה וַיַּרְא־שָׁם֙ אִשָּׁ֣ה זוֹנָ֔ה וַיָּבֹ֖א אֵלֶֽיהָ׃

rows.candidateRo: S-a spus oamenilor din Gaza: „Samson a venit aici.” Și l-au înconjurat și au pândit toată noaptea la poarta cetății. Au stat liniștiți toată noaptea și au zis: „Când se va lumina de ziuă, îl vom omorî.”
rows.WEBU: The Gazites were told, “Samson is here!” They surrounded him and laid wait for him all night in the gate of the city, and were quiet all the night, saying, “Wait until morning light; then we will kill him.”
rows.WLC: לַֽעַזָּתִ֣ים ׀ לֵאמֹ֗ר בָּ֤א שִׁמְשׁוֹן֙ הֵ֔נָּה וַיָּסֹ֛בּוּ וַיֶּאֶרְבוּ־ל֥וֹ כָל־הַלַּ֖יְלָה בְּשַׁ֣עַר הָעִ֑יר וַיִּתְחָרְשׁ֤וּ כָל־הַלַּ֙יְלָה֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר עַד־א֥וֹר הַבֹּ֖קֶר וַהֲרְגְנֻֽהוּ׃

rows.candidateRo: Samson a rămas culcat până la miezul nopții. Pe la miezul nopții, s-a sculat și a apucat porțile cetății cu amândoi stâlpii, le-a scos împreună cu zăvorul, le-a pus pe umeri și le-a dus pe vârful muntelui din fața Hebronului.
rows.WEBU: Samson lay until midnight, then arose at midnight and took hold of the doors of the gate of the city, with the two posts, and plucked them up, bar and all, and put them on his shoulders and carried them up to the top of the mountain that is before Hebron.
rows.WLC: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֣ב שִׁמְשׁוֹן֮ עַד־חֲצִ֣י הַלַּיְלָה֒ וַיָּ֣קָם ׀ בַּחֲצִ֣י הַלַּ֗יְלָה וַיֶּאֱחֹ֞ז בְּדַלְת֤וֹת שַֽׁעַר־הָעִיר֙ וּבִשְׁתֵּ֣י הַמְּזוּז֔וֹת וַיִּסָּעֵם֙ עִֽם־הַבְּרִ֔יחַ וַיָּ֖שֶׂם עַל־כְּתֵפָ֑יו וַֽיַּעֲלֵם֙ אֶל־רֹ֣אשׁ הָהָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־פְּנֵ֥י חֶבְרֽוֹן׃ פ

rows.candidateRo: După aceea, a iubit pe o femeie în valea Sorec. Ea se numea Dalila.
rows.WEBU: It came to pass afterward that he loved a woman in the valley of Sorek, whose name was Delilah.
rows.WLC: וַֽיְהִי֙ אַחֲרֵי־כֵ֔ן וַיֶּאֱהַ֥ב אִשָּׁ֖ה בְּנַ֣חַל שֹׂרֵ֑ק וּשְׁמָ֖הּ דְּלִילָֽה׃

rows.candidateRo: Domnitorii filistenilor s-au suit la ea și i-au zis: „Înduplecă-l și află de unde-i vine puterea lui cea mare și cum am putea să-l biruim, ca să-l legăm și să-l slăbim, și-ți vom da fiecare câte o mie o sută de sicli de argint.”
rows.WEBU: The lords of the Philistines came up to her and said to her, “Entice him, and see in which his great strength lies, and by what means we may prevail against him, that we may bind him to afflict him; and we will each give you eleven hundred pieces of silver.”
rows.WLC: וַיַּעֲל֨וּ אֵלֶ֜יהָ סַרְנֵ֣י פְלִשְׁתִּ֗ים וַיֹּ֨אמְרוּ לָ֜הּ פַּתִּ֣י אוֹת֗וֹ וּרְאִי֙ בַּמֶּה֙ כֹּח֣וֹ גָד֔וֹל וּבַמֶּה֙ נ֣וּכַל ל֔וֹ וַאֲסַרְנֻ֖הוּ לְעַנֹּת֑וֹ וַאֲנַ֙חְנוּ֙ נִתַּן־לָ֔ךְ אִ֕ישׁ אֶ֥לֶף וּמֵאָ֖ה כָּֽסֶף׃

rows.candidateRo: Dalila a zis lui Samson: „Spune-mi, te rog, de unde-ți vine puterea ta cea mare și cu ce ar trebui să fii legat ca să fii biruit.”
rows.WEBU: Delilah said to Samson, “Please tell me where your great strength lies, and what you might be bound to afflict you.”
rows.WLC: וַתֹּ֤אמֶר דְּלִילָה֙ אֶל־שִׁמְשׁ֔וֹן הַגִּֽידָה־נָּ֣א לִ֔י בַּמֶּ֖ה כֹּחֲךָ֣ גָד֑וֹל וּבַמֶּ֥ה תֵאָסֵ֖ר לְעַנּוֹתֶֽךָ׃

rows.candidateRo: Samson i-a zis: „Dacă aș fi legat cu șapte funii noi, care să nu fie uscate încă, aș slăbi și aș fi ca orice alt om.”
rows.WEBU: Samson said to her, “If they bind me with seven green cords that were never dried, then shall I become weak, and be as another man.”
rows.WLC: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלֶ֙יהָ֙ שִׁמְשׁ֔וֹן אִם־יַאַסְרֻ֗נִי בְּשִׁבְעָ֛ה יְתָרִ֥ים לַחִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־חֹרָ֑בוּ וְחָלִ֥יתִי וְהָיִ֖יתִי כְּאַחַ֥ד הָאָדָֽם׃

rows.candidateRo: Domnitorii filistenilor au adus Dalilei șapte funii noi, neuscate încă. Și ea l-a legat cu funiile acestea.
rows.WEBU: Then the lords of the Philistines brought up to her seven green cords which had not been dried, and she bound him with them.
rows.WLC: וַיַּעֲלוּ־לָ֞הּ סַרְנֵ֣י פְלִשְׁתִּ֗ים שִׁבְעָ֛ה יְתָרִ֥ים לַחִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־חֹרָ֑בוּ וַתַּאַסְרֵ֖הוּ בָּהֶֽם׃

rows.candidateRo: Iar niște oameni stăteau la pândă la ea, într-o odaie. Ea i-a zis: „Filistenii sunt asupra ta, Samson!”
rows.WEBU: Now she had an ambush waiting in the inner room. She said to him, “The Philistines are on you, Samson!” He broke the cords as a flax thread is broken when it touches the fire. So his strength was not known.
rows.WLC: וְהָאֹרֵ֗ב יֹשֵׁ֥ב לָהּ֙ בַּחֶ֔דֶר וַתֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֔יו פְּלִשְׁתִּ֥ים עָלֶ֖יךָ שִׁמְשׁ֑וֹן וַיְנַתֵּק֙ אֶת־הַיְתָרִ֔ים כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר יִנָּתֵ֤ק פְּתִֽיל־הַנְּעֹ֙רֶת֙ בַּהֲרִיח֣וֹ אֵ֔שׁ וְלֹ֥א נוֹדַ֖ע כֹּחֽוֹ׃

rows.candidateRo: Dalila a zis lui Samson: „Vezi, ți-ai bătut joc de mine, mi-ai spus minciuni. Acum, te rog, arată-mi cu ce trebuie să fii legat.”
rows.WEBU: Delilah said to Samson, “Behold, you have mocked me, and told me lies. Now please tell me how you might be bound.”
rows.WLC: וַתֹּ֤אמֶר דְּלִילָה֙ אֶל־שִׁמְשׁ֔וֹן הִנֵּה֙ הֵתַ֣לְתָּ בִּ֔י וַתְּדַבֵּ֥ר אֵלַ֖י כְּזָבִ֑ים עַתָּה֙ הַגִּֽידָה־נָּ֣א לִ֔י בַּמֶּ֖ה תֵּאָסֵֽר׃

rows.candidateRo: El i-a zis: „Dacă aș fi legat cu funii noi, care să nu fi fost întrebuințate niciodată, aș slăbi și aș fi ca orice alt om.”
rows.WEBU: He said to her, “If they only bind me with new ropes with which no work has been done, then I will become weak, and be as another man.”
rows.WLC: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלֶ֔יהָ אִם־אָס֤וֹר יַאַסְר֙וּנִי֙ בַּעֲבֹתִ֣ים חֲדָשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹֽא־נַעֲשָׂ֥ה בָהֶ֖ם מְלָאכָ֑ה וְחָלִ֥יתִי וְהָיִ֖יתִי כְּאַחַ֥ד הָאָדָֽם׃

rows.candidateRo: Dalila a luat niște funii noi și l-a legat cu ele. Apoi i-a zis: „Filistenii sunt asupra ta, Samson!”
rows.WEBU: So Delilah took new ropes and bound him with them, then said to him, “The Philistines are on you, Samson!” The ambush was waiting in the inner room. He broke them off his arms like a thread.
